title: CobbleMary
description: A multiplayer-ready Cobblemon modpack built for group exploration, battles, and Pokémon-catching adventures.
body:
This modpack is created for players who want the best Cobblemon experience, whether playing solo or together with friends. It focuses on delivering smoother performance, cleaner gameplay, and a more enjoyable world to explore without changing the core feel of Cobblemon. Every mod included has been selected to enhance the overall experience—making catching, battling, and exploring with friends feel natural, stable, and fun.

With improved performance optimizations, players can enjoy smoother framerates even on lower-end devices. The enhanced world generation makes exploration more exciting, giving players more reasons to travel, find rare Pokémon, and build bases together. Quality-of-life improvements refine the UI, controls, and general interactions, making the game easier and more comfortable to play for both new and experienced Cobblemon players.

This modpack is perfect for multiplayer sessions. Whether you're playing on a small private server or inviting friends to join your world, everything is set up to be compatible and stable. Trading, battling, and exploring together all work seamlessly, creating a fun and cooperative Cobblemon adventure.

Easy to install, optimized for performance, and made for friends—this modpack brings the Cobblemon experience to the next level.
